--yes is ignored: plugin add always asks you.
Agentflow plugin.install: confirm (default)
Add plugin ci-notify 0.1.0: "CI failure notifications"
  from      "<plugin-src>"
  hash      sha256:<digest-1>
  tier      declarative
  receives  gh.ci.updated
  publishes nothing
  runs      notify
  settings  signal
  adds
    handler ci-failed: on gh.ci.updated (2 conditions) then invoke notify
! This plugin runs no code of its own: agentflow reads its rules and does only what its permissions allow.
! Writes the plugin starts (notify) wait for your approval before they run.
It stays turned off until you turn it on: open Settings and tick plugins.ci-notify.enabled, or run: agentflow config set plugins.ci-notify.enabled=true
